meta.name: eol-process
meta.description: Run a product sunset end to end — decide, align, plan, prepare, announce, close. Use when you need the whole EOL process, not just one artifact.

copy.tagline: 从决策到收尾,跑通产品退市全流程
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你正负责产品停止服务的完整流程
copy.tagline_en: Run a full product end-of-life process from decision to closure
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're managing the complete process of retiring a product

howto.what: 装好后,Claude 会带你走完产品退市的六个阶段:决策、对齐、规划、准备、公告、收尾,逐步产出对应文件(如利益相关方顺序、检查清单、客户公告等)。它还会根据退市规模(轻/标准/重)调整流程详略,并在中途出错时帮你找出被跳过的阶段。
howto.when: 当你需要整个产品退市流程而非某个单一文件时触发。你可以从任意位置进入(如决策前、决策后或中途),描述当前情况即可。

say.text: 帮我完整跑一遍旧版报表模块的退市流程,决策已定,其他还没开始。
say.note: 他会从决策后的对齐阶段开始带你走。

say.text: 我们三周前宣布了停售,现在客服快被投诉淹没了,我们漏了哪一步?
say.note: 他会用诊断表定位被跳过的阶段。

say.text: 我们决定退休一个产品,我全权负责,带我走完整个流程。
say.note: 他会按六阶段顺序推进。

howto.what_en: Claude runs a full product sunset end to end: decide, align, plan, prepare, announce, close. It produces each phase's artifact, adjusts detail to the sunset's level, and finds skipped phases if you're mid-stream.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask for the whole EOL process, not just one artifact. You can enter empty-handed or mid-stream; it will route from there.

say_en.text: Run the full EOL process for our legacy reporting module — decision made, nothing else started.
say_en.note: Claude starts from Phase 2 after the decision.

say_en.text: We announced a sunset three weeks ago and Support is drowning. What did we skip?
say_en.note: It runs the diagnostic to find the skipped phase.

say_en.text: We've decided to retire a product and I own the whole thing — walk me through it end to end.
say_en.note: It guides you through all six phases in order.
